newsitem.title: USA: Lindberg Corp Q4 net slides as sales slip.
newsitem.headline: Lindberg Corp Q4 net slides as sales slip.

text.p: Lindberg Corp said Friday disappointing results at its precision products segment contributed to a 33-percent drop in earnings in the fourth quarter ended December 31.
The company reported net income of $1.2 million, down from $1.8 million in the corresponding period last year. Revenues reached $27.4 million, down from $29.7 million in the fourth quarter of 1995.
The company said the precision products unit had more robust sales one year ago.
Lindberg provides commercial heat treating services to the metalworking industry. Its shares were up 1/4 Friday at 9-1/4.
